author: Cvico
body:
#### PR description:

Adds two jet b-tagging discriminators of the jet matched to each muon to the custom muon NanoAOD (`PhysicsTools/NanoAOD/python/custom_muon_cff.py`):

- `Muon_jetPNetB`: ParticleNet b vs. udscg score
- `Muon_jetUParTB`: UParT b vs. udscg score

They follow the same pattern as the existing `Muon_jetDF` and `Muon_jetCSVv2` variables. They use `jetForLepJetVar`, the same jet used as input to the prompt MVA, and default to -1 when there is no matched jet.

The idea is to integrate this into v16 nanoAODs. Which release should we backport to?

#### PR validation:

I produced NanoAOD from the same 10 input events with three configurations, using `CMSSW_15_0_22`. I did this because we want these to work for NanoAODv15/v16, so the idea is to backport this commits to the branches that will be used for that. Let me know if it has to be tested also in the master branch (since the conditions change, I get some issues when running NanoAOD, that I thought were because 20X is supposed to be phase 2). I'm not an expert on releases beyond the Run 3 ones.

1. Common NanoAOD (`reference_commonNano`)

```bash
cmsDriver.py  \
--scenario pp \
--era Run3_2024 \
--customise Configuration/DataProcessing/Utils.addMonitoring \
--step NANO \
--conditions 150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2 \
--datatier NANOAODSIM \
--eventcontent NANOAODSIM0 \
--python_filename reference_Nano.py \
--fileout file:reference_Nano.root \
--filein "dbs:/DYto2Mu-4Jets_Bin-MLL-50_TuneCP5_13p6TeV_madgraphMLM-pythia8/RunIII2024Summer24MiniAODv6-150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2-v3/MINIAODSIM" \
--number 10 \
--number_out 10 \
--no_exec \
--mc;
```

2. Custom muon NanoAOD without this change (`reference_muoNano`)

```bash
cmsDriver.py  \
--scenario pp \
--era Run3_2024 \
--customise Configuration/DataProcessing/Utils.addMonitoring \
--step NANO:@MUPOG \
--conditions 150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2 \
--datatier NANOAODSIM \
--eventcontent NANOAODSIM0 \
--python_filename reference_muoNano.py \
--fileout file:reference_muoNano.root \
--filein "dbs:/DYto2Mu-4Jets_Bin-MLL-50_TuneCP5_13p6TeV_madgraphMLM-pythia8/RunIII2024Summer24MiniAODv6-150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2-v3/MINIAODSIM" \
--number 10 \
--number_out 10 \
--no_exec \
--mc;
```

3. Custom muon NanoAOD with this change (`modified_muoNano`)
```bash
cmsDriver.py  \
--scenario pp \
--era Run3_2024 \
--customise Configuration/DataProcessing/Utils.addMonitoring \
--step NANO:@MUPOG \
--conditions 150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2 \
--datatier NANOAODSIM \
--eventcontent NANOAODSIM0 \
--python_filename modified_muoNano.py \
--fileout file:modified_muoNano.root \
--filein "dbs:/DYto2Mu-4Jets_Bin-MLL-50_TuneCP5_13p6TeV_madgraphMLM-pythia8/RunIII2024Summer24MiniAODv6-150X_mcRun3_2024_realistic_v2-v3/MINIAODSIM" \
--number 10 \
--number_out 10 \
--no_exec \
--mc;
```

and compared the muons present in both files, matched per event by eta/phi.

- **Modified vs. custom muon reference:** all 21 muons match. All 188 common `Muon_*` branches are identical. The only new branches are `Muon_jetPNetB` and `Muon_jetUParTB`.
- **Modified vs. common NanoAOD:** all 13 common muons match, and all 77 common `Muon_*` branches agree. This includes `Muon_promptMVA` and `Muon_mvaLowPt`. The only exception is `Muon_jetDF`, which differs by at most 3e-5 for 2 of the 13 muons, consistent with the branch precision. The custom file has more muons because of the `pt > 2` selection.
- **New b-tag variables:** `Muon_jetPNetB` and `Muon_jetUParTB` were compared with `Jet_btagPNetB` and `Jet_btagUParTAK4B` of the jet at `Muon_jetIdx` in the common NanoAOD. Scores agree to within 1e-4 for the 12 muons with a matched jet. The one muon with no jet has -1 in both new variables.

This is a small-statistics check (10 events, 13 common muons).

Tagging @NTrevisani as L3 Selection convener too.
title: Included new taggers for muon NanoAOD
